beats.caption: Golard. Here is the story of Golard and its 21 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 71, 70 and 61 people in Golard, in 23, 20 and 16 households. Heads of household included Bustard, Martin and Brodbin.
Here are the families of Golard, from 1901 to 1926. First, the Bustard and Martin families.
The Bustard family appear in the records from 1901 to 1926.

Golard had two Bustard households in 1911, headed by Susan and Charles.
Golard had two Bustard households in 1926, headed by John and Maggie.
